experiment: E4 spectral fan-out allocation: evaluation of stages 1 and 2

criteria_text.stage1: at beta = 0, f* is flat (CV < 0.05) with AP within +-1% of even fan-out; the best grid exponent alpha decreases in beta and in k (Spearman <= -0.8)
criteria_text.stage2: pass at k in {4, 16}: f* (AP) lies inside the best-grid-alpha 95% trial-bootstrap interval on 3 of 3 datasets, AND f* beats both even fan-out and the best (validation-chosen) lambda^(alpha/2) input pre-scaling (paired 95% intervals excluding 0) on >= 2 of 3 datasets
criteria_text.primary: stage 1 AND stage 2; a near miss is a fail
